title: Pair signed task directions to attain the deterministic worst-case precision frontier
statement: For fixed symmetric S=S0+H with the entire prior H=H^T,||H||op<=R, R>0, and each real unit-bounded input q returning S*q+e with arbitrary ||e||2<=eta, let tail_k(T) omit the k largest positive and k largest negative magnitudes of symmetric T separately. At most k deterministic possibly adaptive vector calls have exact minimax task radius eta*||T||_*+(R-eta)*tail_k(T) for0<=eta<=R. For eta>=R, zero calls attain the optimal prior radius R*||T||_*.

requires: The whole symmetric operator-norm ball and calibrated R, not merely an outer enclosure of a smaller feasible set. If positivity is added, retain the full ball (e.g. S0>=R*I) or reanalyze the lower bound.
Arbitrary programmable real ||q||2<=1 and full-vector return; every per-call Euclidean error within eta is permitted, including source/history-dependent adversarial choices.
A fixed symmetric late task and deterministic policies; no randomized statistical or input-precision guarantee is asserted.
provides: For fixed symmetric S=S0+H with the entire prior H=H^T,||H||op<=R, R>0, and each real unit-bounded input q returning S*q+e with arbitrary ||e||2<=eta, let tail_k(T) omit the k largest positive and k largest negative magnitudes of symmetric T separately. At most k deterministic possibly adaptive vector calls have exact minimax task radius eta*||T||_*+(R-eta)*tail_k(T) for0<=eta<=R. For eta>=R, zero calls attain the optimal prior radius R*||T||_*.
assumptions: Rational/catalogue-only actions, source formulas, extra posterior constraints, heterogeneous errors or additional joint noise restrictions can change the optimum. Correlated errors within the declared individual-bound class are already allowed.
This does not supersede N997's different general/retained-history interfaces or supply the native instrument.
costs: k vector calls return k*n coordinates, plus eigendirection calculation, decoder arithmetic, encoding/preparation and real precision costs. A same-information conventional retaining method ties.
contract.units: Normalized Euclidean inputs; R,eta are response/action units, T dual task units. Tail and nuclear norm use signed spectral magnitudes; calls and coordinate counts are separate.
contract.obstruction: Acquire the actual source/error/input contract before using the sharp number as an experimental resource guarantee.

body: For a positive eigenpair(lambda,u+) and negative(-mu,u-), use q=(sqrt(lambda)*u+ + sqrt(mu)*u-)/sqrt(lambda+mu) and y=sqrt(lambda+mu)*(sqrt(lambda)*u+ - sqrt(mu)*u-). Then sym(q*y^T)=lambda*u+u+^T-mu*u-u-^T and ||y||=lambda+mu; unpaired directions use their signed eigenvalue. Estimate tr(T*S0)+sum y_j^T(z_j-S0*q_j). The omitted spectral tail pays R and acquired directions pay eta. For any decoder factors, Z=sum sym(q_j*y_j^T) has at most k positive and k negative eigenvalues; interlacing forces ||T-Z||_*>=tail_k. The dual objective R||T-Z||_*+eta*sum||y_j|| cannot beat the formula. Returning central S0*q_j fixes a deterministic adaptive branch and leaves an indistinguishable symmetric pair. A requested tolerance below the eta*||T||_* floor is impossible under this contract, not under all possible instruments.
